methodological_rigor.justification: The study characterizes collagen-based microtissues with a coherent battery of orthogonal assays: live/dead staining, CellTiter-Glo 3D ATP, IHC cleaved caspase-3, HypoxiTRAK hypoxia probe, flow cytometry CD44+/CD24- against multiple 3D benchmarks (2D, spheroids, collagen domes, laminin domes), bulk RNA-seq with DESeq2 and clusterProfiler, 7-point dose-response for 5 chemotherapeutics, and a confocal doxorubicin diffusion time course. Two biologically divergent TNBC cell lines (HCC1806 epithelial-like and MDA-MB-231 mesenchymal-like) strengthen generalizability. Limitations include only two cell lines, no patient-derived validation, only two biological replicates for RNA-seq, and incomplete mechanistic dissection of paclitaxel resistance. Statistics rely on one-way ANOVA with Tukey for CSC comparisons and DESeq2 FDR<0.05 with |log2FC|>1 for RNA-seq, which is appropriate; however, no power calculation or explicit CI reporting is given for dose-response IC50s.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Preclinical in vitro platform development using cell lines, mapping to Oxford LoE 5. The translational relevance lies in providing an alternative 3D model for drug screening; authors align IC50 ranges with clinical Cmax values from the literature (refs 45-49), supporting physiological relevance. However, no patient-derived tumor samples or clinical correlation are tested, so translational applicability remains plausible but unproven as acknowledged by the authors.

reporting_quality.justification: Methods are detailed for cell culture, microtissue fabrication (cutting plate, tubing, cell density), assay conditions, and bioinformatics (STAR, DESeq2, clusterProfiler with versions). Figure legends report n, technical/biological replicates, scale bars, statistical tests (ANOVA with Tukey, * p-value annotation scheme), and reagent catalog numbers. RNA-seq raw data are deposited in SRA (PRJNA1414100), earning a strong data-availability score. No dedicated reporting standard exists for 3D cell-culture platforms, and REDACTED fields in background text are intrinsic to blinding. Code/analysis scripts are not explicitly shared, preventing a 5.

novelty_literature.justification: Modular tissue engineering with sub-millimeter collagen modules has been previously established by the same senior author's group for healthy tissues (refs 36-39, 43-44, 52-53); this is the first application described for TNBC tumor modeling. The methodology itself (collagen hydrogel + cutting plate) is incremental adaptation rather than a novel platform concept, and benchmarking against spheroids/domes is standard practice. The observation of cell-line-dependent CD44+/CD24- enrichment and paclitaxel-specific resistance is meaningful but not field-defining. A score of 3 reflects a competent extension rather than a novel discovery.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is clearly written with a coherent narrative from fabrication through architecture, transcriptomics, stemness benchmarking, hypoxia, and drug response. Figures are described with detailed legends, Table 1 systematically compares model systems, and the Discussion transparently acknowledges limitations (CSC marker caveats in MDA-MB-231, absence of stromal/immune components, no patient-derived validation). Minor REDACTED tokens in the abstract and introduction are blinding artifacts.

key_strengths: Orthogonal characterization combining histology, RNA-seq, flow cytometry CSC benchmarking, hypoxia probing, and multi-drug dose-response
Two biologically divergent TNBC cell lines (epithelial-like HCC1806 and mesenchymal-like MDA-MB-231) used throughout
RNA-seq raw data publicly deposited (SRA PRJNA1414100); detailed bioinformatics tool versions reported
Transparent benchmarking against spheroids, collagen domes, and laminin-rich domes for CD44+/CD24- quantification
Physiological relevance supported by comparison to clinical Cmax values for paclitaxel, doxorubicin, docetaxel, vincristine, and vinblastine
key_concerns: Only two cell lines tested; no patient-derived tumor samples or primary cell validation
RNA-seq based on only two biological replicates, limiting statistical power for differential expression
Incremental methodological novelty - modular microtissue platform previously published for healthy tissues by the same group
Paclitaxel-specific resistance observed but molecular mechanism (beta-tubulin, efflux, UPR) not experimentally dissected
No stromal, immune, or endothelial components incorporated - acknowledged but limits tumor microenvironment fidelity
chief_reviewer.rationale: Well-executed methodological characterization with appropriate orthogonal assays and transparent limitations; suitable for Tier 3 specialty journal with minor revisions to strengthen biological replication and mechanistic follow-up.
